newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Simac buys Dutch Lorje Computers.
newsitem.headline: Simac buys Dutch Lorje Computers.

text.p: Dutch information technology group Simac Techniek NV said on Tuesday it had taken over Lorje Computers Nederland BV.
"Lorje is expected to have a neutral to slightly positive effect on the (Simac) earnings per share in the first year," Simac said.
Lorje is a dealer of Compaq, Hewlett-Packard, IBM and Toshiba. Most of the company's clients are large and medium-sized companies and institutions.
Simac said Lorje, whose figures will be included in the Simac results from July 1 of this year, expected 1997 turnover of more than 80 million guilders.
Simac itself expects this year's sales to total more than 400 million guilders. The company posted 1996 net profit of 4.8 million guilders on turnover of 297.4 million.
